quests.dispatcherQuestion: Advanced bioweapon deployment in a densely populated metropolitan area. Input code!
quests.hint: Initiate a metropolitan biological lockdown.
quests.explanation: Metropolitan biological lockdowns restrict movement, activate field hospitals, and deploy targeted prophylaxis distribution.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Casualty numbers rising exponentially requiring urgent surge capacity planning. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the exponential surge capacity plan.
quests.explanation: Exponential surge plans scale healthcare resources ahead of the predicted curve to prevent system collapse under demand.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Medical countermeasure stockpile being requested from the national reserve. Input code!
quests.hint: Request strategic national stockpile deployment.
quests.explanation: Strategic national stockpile deployment provides emergency medicines and vaccines within 12 hours to any affected location.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Super-eruption volcano producing ash cloud at stratospheric altitude. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue a global aviation ban for the ash region.
quests.explanation: Stratospheric ash clouds can shut down continental-scale airspace for weeks, requiring international coordination of the ban.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Agricultural impact from ash deposition threatening the regional food supply. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue a regional food security alert.
quests.explanation: Food security alerts activate emergency food distribution and import prioritization to prevent shortages during ash fall.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Respiratory illness cases surging in populations near the volcanic ash fallout. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate ash-related medical surge protocols.
quests.explanation: Ash medical surges prioritize respiratory treatment, distribute N95 masks, and advise indoor sheltering to reduce exposure.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Simultaneous attacks detected on power, water, and communications infrastructure. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue the critical infrastructure attack code.
quests.explanation: Critical infrastructure attack codes activate coordinated national defense across all essential service sectors simultaneously.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Cascade effects spreading from attacked sectors to dependent services. Input code!
quests.hint: Implement cascade limitation protocols.
quests.explanation: Cascade limitation protocols break dependency chains between sectors, preventing attacks from propagating across infrastructure.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: National security emergency declared requiring military support to protect infrastructure. Input code!
quests.hint: Request military infrastructure protection.
quests.explanation: Military infrastructure protection teams defend physical assets and support civilian agencies restoring attacked systems.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Pandemic command transferring from health ministry to emergency management authority. Input code!
quests.hint: Execute the emergency management command transfer.
quests.explanation: Command transfer protocols maintain operational continuity by briefing the incoming authority on all active commitments.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Legal authority framework must be formalized for the new command structure. Input code!
quests.hint: Formalize the legal authority framework.
quests.explanation: Formal legal authority prevents operational uncertainty and ensures responders act within defined statutory powers.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International observers requiring accreditation for the command transfer process. Input code!
quests.hint: Accredit all international observers.
quests.explanation: Observer accreditation ensures transparency in the command transfer process and maintains international confidence.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Space station requiring emergency evacuation due to a life-threatening system failure. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue the space station evacuation order.
quests.explanation: Station evacuation orders initiate Soyuz undocking procedures and notify ground teams to prepare landing zones.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Only one Soyuz capsule available for three crew members requiring prioritization. Input code!
quests.hint: Set the crew evacuation priority order.
quests.explanation: Crew evacuation priority considers medical status, mission-critical knowledge, and calculated life-expectancy factors.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Ground controllers managing two parallel rescue operations for the stranded crew. Input code!
quests.hint: Coordinate dual rescue operations.
quests.explanation: Dual rescue coordination requires two independent ground control teams on separate frequencies to prevent errors.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Two military submarines colliding underwater with crew casualties onboard. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue a submarine collision emergency alert.
quests.explanation: Submarine collision alerts mobilize deep submergence rescue vehicles within their 72-hour deployment window.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Both submarines maintaining watertight integrity but unable to surface independently. Input code!
quests.hint: Launch the Deep Submergence Rescue Vehicle.
quests.explanation: DSRV operations mate to disabled submarine escape hatches and transfer crew to the surface in multiple trips.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International submarine rescue cooperation activated with allied nations. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue SUBMISS notification to all allied nations.
quests.explanation: SUBMISS notification immediately activates allied submarine rescue assets, which may be closer than domestic resources.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Nuclear plant Loss of Coolant Accident progressing toward core fuel exposure. Input code!
quests.hint: Execute the LOCA emergency response.
quests.explanation: LOCA responses combine high-pressure injection, low-pressure injection, and reflood operations based on the accident stage.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Fuel damage indicators showing cladding failure in 40% of fuel assemblies. Input code!
quests.hint: Enhance fuel damage monitoring immediately.
quests.explanation: Enhanced monitoring tracks hydrogen and noble gas releases that indicate the extent of fuel cladding degradation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Emergency feedwater needed to maintain fuel temperature below the damage threshold. Input code!
quests.hint: Inject emergency feedwater to the core.
quests.explanation: Emergency feedwater injection maintains a water level over the fuel, preventing catastrophic overheating and meltdown.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Mass casualty incident involving a radiological weapon in the commercial district. Input code!
quests.hint: Declare a radiological mass casualty response.
quests.explanation: Radiological mass casualty responses combine dose assessment, wound treatment, and decontamination in priority order.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Hundreds of patients requiring simultaneous radiation dose assessment. Input code!
quests.hint: Initiate the biodosimetry assessment program.
quests.explanation: Biodosimetry uses lymphocyte depletion rates and chromosomal analysis to estimate radiation doses for each patient.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Potassium iodide and bone marrow support drugs required in large quantities. Input code!
quests.hint: Push radiological medical countermeasures.
quests.explanation: Radiological medical countermeasures including bone marrow stimulants must be deployed within 24 hours of high-dose exposure.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Global pathogen detected with pandemic potential requiring WHO emergency declaration. Input code!
quests.hint: Request a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern declaration.
quests.explanation: PHEIC declarations mobilize international treaty obligations including resource sharing, travel advisories, and global coordination.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Rapid development of medical countermeasures required by international consortium. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the international MCDC consortium.
quests.explanation: Medical Countermeasure Development Consortiums accelerate vaccine and treatment development through parallel global research.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Global pathogen surveillance network activated for real-time variant tracking. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the global pathogen tracking network.
quests.explanation: Global pathogen tracking integrates genetic sequencing data from every nation to detect emerging variants in near real-time.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Advanced multi-agency emergency operations center activated for a complex disaster. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the advanced multi-agency EOC.
quests.explanation: Advanced EOC activation integrates law enforcement, health, utilities, and military under a single operational picture.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Incoming intelligence requiring real-time integration into operational decisions. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the intelligence fusion process.
quests.explanation: Intelligence fusion combines data from field reports, sensors, and classified sources into a unified operational picture.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: EOC transitioning from response to recovery phase requiring protocol update. Input code!
quests.hint: Transition the EOC to recovery phase operations.
quests.explanation: Recovery phase protocols shift focus from life-saving operations to infrastructure restoration and community support.
